points.description: Names plasma (प्लाज्मा / रक्तद्रव) as the blood component that mainly contains salts, proteins, sugar and other nutrients. Accept the spelling प्लाझ्मा or an equivalent Marathi term for plasma; do not accept red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets or serum.

rubric.notes: Full marks are earned only by naming plasma (प्लाज्मा/रक्तद्रव) as the blood component. No marks are given for naming blood cells, platelets or serum. This is a one-mark, all-or-nothing recall question.
